messages:
cost-alert-bot: GPU cost alert: costcenter=research-playground exceeded soft threshold by 38% during 2026-03-22 00:00-06:00 UTC. Peak in asia-southeast. See /alerts/2279999999.
oliver-fin: Noted. Any idea which jobs blew the budget? we need a quick attribution before running chargebacks.
ashley-ops: Looking at instance tags, most are 'experiment-*' or missing tags. I've started a query to join GCE instances -> k8s pod annotations -> job metadata. Will post CSV.
ashley-ops: Query snippet: ```SELECT inst_id, label_project, pod_annotation_owner, gpu_type, start_ts, end_ts, (end_ts-start_ts)*gpu_count AS gpu_hours FROM `billing.instance_usage` WHERE start_ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AND region LIKE '%asia%';```
sam-ml: quick heads up 5% of running sweeps yesterday had feature flag `pricing-experiment:raise` enabled by default in the demo branch. I toggled it for dev, but maybe the rollout included playground.
tara-product: That flag was part of a short A/B to test scheduling on high-memory nodes. It should have been limited to `team=product` projects only.
oliver-fin: If the experiment landed on playground, finance would expect costs to be charged to the experiment budget (costcenter=prod-experiments). Can infra reassign where possible?
ashley-ops: I can map pod_annotation_owner -> team and then remap costs. If owner missing, fallback to project billing tag, then to `unallocated-playground`. Will produce `/reports/chargebacks/2279999999.csv` with columns: owner, team, project, gpu_model, gpu_hours, cost_usd, recompute_reason.
billing-bot: Note: vendor invoice INV-2026-042 shows a region uplift for asia-southeast during the same window; discrepancy ~1.8% vs estimate. Flagging for vendor inquiry.
oliver-fin: Good to know. If vendor uplift matches spike window we should request a rebate for the experimental misrouting. Sam, can you confirm which commit toggled the flag and when?
sam-ml: commit b7f2c3 toggled default in demo-config at 2026-03-21T22:14Z. I'll open a PR to revert and add stricter targeting.
tara-product: I'll notify the product teams and owners to approve any internal recharges. Prefer to absorb small amounts under the experiments budget, but larger recharges need owner signoff.
ashley-ops: CSV uploaded: `/mnt/fin/reports/chargebacks/2279999999.csv` (shared w/ finance + product). Sample rows: `sam-ml,prod-ml,proj-prod1,H100,12.5,312.5,pricing-experiment`
oliver-fin: I'll review and draft chargeback notes. If total reassignable > $5k we'll route formal approvals. Action items: 1) ashley finish full attribution (due +1h) 2) sam identify config rollout path and revert (due +30m) 3) finance prepare chargeback CSV and approval thread (due +2h) 4) ops + finance to open vendor inquiry if uplift overlaps spike (due +3h).
ashley-ops: starting enrichment now. will ping when the final CSV and summary are ready. :mag:
